The main takeaway from our work is that

the Fourier coefficients of the radial projections can be used to compute local features that are robust to rotation, partial occlusion and scaling, which is not the case for many other local feature descriptors.
the complex coefficients of radial projections can be used as a local feature that is rotation-discriminating, robust to scaling, and robust to partial occlusion.
rotation-discriminating local features of radial projections can be efficiently computed and used to find templates that cannot be found by conventional local feature-based template matchings.
